title: Active Directory decoys: domains, decoy users and computers, the deployment script, and the alert triggers that feed them

subjects.title: Active Directory decoys: domains, decoy users and computers, the deployment script, and the alert triggers that feed them
subjects.lead: AD decoys are listed against MITRE ATT&CK T1110 (Brute Force), T1558 (Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets) and T1087.002 (Account Discovery: Domain Account).
